# Acme Corporation Engineering Runbook & Incident Protocols

## Section 1: Deployment & Staging Pipelines
- Automated staging builds trigger via GitHub Actions on every pull request to the `develop` branch.
- Production deployments occur exclusively on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST following QA sign-off.
- The emergency deployment rollback command is `make deploy-rollback-immediate`.

## Section 2: Database Failover & Replication
- The primary PostgreSQL read-write replica runs in region us-east-1.
- Secondary warm-standby read instances are maintained in us-west-2 and eu-west-1.
- Database automatic promotion threshold: failover initiates if health-check heartbeats drop for 45 consecutive seconds.
- Primary database connection pool size is capped at 120 active connections per worker instance.

## Section 3: Internal Monitoring & Observability
- Datadog dashboard cluster tag: `acme-prod-telemetry-01`.
- Sentry DSN project identifier: `org-error-tracker-8831`.
- On-call escalation schedule rotations update weekly on Mondays at 00:00 UTC.

# Acme Corporation Enterprise Handbook & Operational Protocols

## Section 1: Corporate Governance and Organizational Hierarchy
Acme Corporation operates under a distributed executive matrix designed to promote autonomy across regional engineering teams while ensuring regulatory compliance with international financial and data protection standards. The executive leadership committee consists of the Chief Executive Officer, Chief Operating Officer, Chief Technology Officer, and General Counsel. The board of directors convenes on the final Thursday of each financial quarter to review operational budgets, executive equity allocations, risk exposure matrices, and key performance indicators across all active business units.

All operational decisions involving expenditures exceeding $50,000 require dual authorization from both the department head and the Vice President of Finance. Strategic partnerships involving exclusive licensing or co-marketing commitments must be accompanied by an independent legal assessment prepared by external counsel prior to execution.

## Section 2: Global Infrastructure, Cloud Topology, and Networking
Our production infrastructure is deployed across multiple cloud providers to avoid single-vendor dependencies and maintain 99.99% availability SLAs for enterprise clients. The primary compute layer is deployed across Amazon Web Services (AWS) in us-east-1 and us-west-2, with warm disaster recovery standby clusters provisioned in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) europe-west3.

Internal traffic routes exclusively through private VPC peering tunnels protected by mutual TLS 1.3 encryption. External public ingress is managed via Cloudflare Enterprise edge nodes running custom Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules designed to filter Layer 7 distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) vectors. The edge routing rules enforce strict rate-limiting caps of 1,200 requests per minute per authenticated enterprise tenant API key. Any IP address exhibiting erratic traffic spikes exceeding 300% of baseline volume is automatically isolated into an ephemeral challenge sandbox for 15 minutes.

## Section 3: Engineering Incident Management and Escalation Ladders
Incident response follows a tiered Severity Classification framework ranging from SEV-1 (critical outage impacting greater than 5% of active users) to SEV-4 (minor cosmetic or documentation defect). When a SEV-1 or SEV-2 incident is detected by our Datadog synthetics, an automated PagerDuty alert triggers the primary on-call Site Reliability Engineer (SRE).

The incident commander assumes complete operational authority over the production environment for the duration of the event. All incident deliberations, live debugging logs, and rollback commands must be posted in the dedicated Slack war-room channel (#incident-active-war-room). The engineering team must produce a blameless post-mortem retrospective within 72 hours of incident resolution, detailing the root cause analysis, timeline of diagnostic steps, remediation actions, and preventative backlog work items.

## Section 4: Data Retention, Backup Cadence, and Compliance Audits
In compliance with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR Article 32 mandates, all relational databases undergo continuous incremental write-ahead log archiving with a recovery point objective (RPO) of under 5 minutes. Full automated database snapshots occur nightly at 02:00 UTC and are mirrored to immutable, air-gapped S3 Glacier buckets with Object Lock enabled for 365 days.

Customer personal identifiable information (PII) is encrypted at rest using envelope encryption with per-tenant customer-managed KMS keys. Audit logs recording all database reads, role escalations, and administrative modifications are retained for a minimum of 7 years in read-only cold storage. Any employee who discovers unencrypted credentials, sensitive API keys, or leaked customer records must notify compliance-ops@acme-corp.internal within 60 minutes.

# Acme Corporation Board & Executive Compensation Strategy - Highly Confidential

## Section 1: Executive Bonus Allocation Matrix (Q3/Q4)
- Chief Executive Officer (CEO) target performance bonus multiplier: 2.2x base salary, contingent on achieving $25M ARR.
- Chief Technology Officer (CTO) retention equity allocation: 45,000 RSUs vesting quarterly over a 36-month period.
- Chief Financial Officer (CFO) discretionary bonus pool approval code: "EXEC-DISCRETIONARY-POOL-998".

## Section 2: Mergers & Acquisitions Target Assessment
- Target Project Codename: "Project Bluefin"
- Evaluation Budget: $14.5M cash reserve allocated for potential asset acquisition of regional competitor.
- Board Approval Quorum: Requires minimum 4 of 5 voting directors by October 15.
